# readin 
```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(lme4)
library(tibble)
library(stringr) 
library(ggplot2)
library(colorspace)
# ============================================================ 
library(lmerTest)     # p-values for fixed effects
library(performance)  # marginal R^2 


path <- "/Users/mlin2/Desktop/RabLab/tasks/concurrent/cleaned_dat/" 
dat_bl <- read_csv(paste0(path, "merged_baseline_wDemo.csv"))
cdr_long <- read_csv(paste0(path,"cdr_cleaned_20260316.csv")) %>% filter(tx_started==0)
```

# longitudinal cdr
```{r}
# select only those with at least one follow up (>= 2 timepoints) in all four modalities
 
dat_bl$log_ptau <- log(dat_bl$ptau217)
# ---- rename + EOAD-only ----
df <- dat_bl %>%
  filter(dx == "EOAD") %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(ptau217),
    !is.na(desikan_suvr),
    !is.na(centiloid_wcbl),
    !is.na(cdrsb)
  )
 
subj_keep <- cdr_long %>%
  filter(subject_label %in% df$subject_label) %>%
  mutate(cdr_date = as.Date(cdr_date)) %>%
  group_by(subject_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cdr = n_distinct(cdr_date[!is.na(cdr_date)]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_cdr >= 2)

# Step 2: keep FULL longitudinal records
df_long <- cdr_long %>%
  semi_join(subj_keep, by = "subject_label")
df_long <- df_long %>%
  left_join(
    df %>%
      dplyr::select(
        subject_label,
        ptau217,
        log_ptau,
        desikan_suvr,
        centiloid_wcbl,
        dx
      ) %>%
      rename(
        ptau217_bl        = ptau217,
        log_ptau_bl       = log_ptau,
        desikan_suvr_bl   = desikan_suvr,
        centiloid_wcbl_bl = centiloid_wcbl
      ),
    by = "subject_label"
  ) %>% filter(
    !is.na(ptau217_bl),
    !is.na(desikan_suvr_bl),
    !is.na(centiloid_wcbl_bl)
  )
# Keep subjects with >= 2 CDR visits
df_long_filtered <- df_long %>%
  group_by(subject_label) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(time_yrs = day_to_baseline_cdr / 365.25)

# Count unique subjects
n_distinct(df_long_filtered$subject_label)
```


# baseline cor
```{R}
# ---- long format for faceting (order: ptau, centiloid, tau) ----
plot_long <- df  %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(log_ptau, centiloid_wcbl, desikan_suvr),
    names_to = "biomarker",
    values_to = "x"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    biomarker = factor(biomarker, levels = c("log_ptau", "centiloid_wcbl", "desikan_suvr")),
    biomarker_lab = recode(
      biomarker,
      ptau      = "Plasma p-tau217 (pg/mL)",
      centiloid = "Amyloid PET (Centiloid)",

    )

mod_colors <- c(
centiloid_wcbl = "lightgreen",
  log_ptau      = "lightblue",
  desikan_suvr = "coral"
)

bcor <- ggplot(plot_long, aes(x = x, y = cdrsb)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.2) +

    method = "lm",
```

# baseline model info 
```{r}
# Models
m_ptau  <- lm(cdrsb ~ log_ptau, data = df)
m_amy   <- lm(cdrsb ~ centiloid_wcbl, data = df)
m_tau   <- lm(cdrsb ~ desikan_suvr, data = df)
 

print_model_info <- function(model) {
  cat("\n============================\n")
  cat("Model:", deparse(formula(model)), "\n")
  cat("============================\n\n")
  
  # Standard summary
  print(summary(model))
  
  # Standardized coefficients
  cat("\n--- Standardized coefficients ---\n")
  print(standardize_parameters(model))
  
  # R-squared
  cat("\n--- Model fit ---\n")
  cat("R-squared:", summary(model)$r.squared, "\n")
  cat("Adjusted R-squared:", summary(model)$adj.r.squared, "\n")
}
print_model_info(m_ptau)
print_model_info(m_amy)
print_model_info(m_tau)
```
```{r}
 

# Fit multivariable baseline model
m_base <- lm(cdrsb ~ log_ptau + centiloid_wcbl + desikan_suvr, data = df)

# 1) Standard summary
summary(m_base)

# 2) Standardized coefficients
standardize_parameters(m_base)
```

# individual LME (random slope and intercept)
```{r} 
fit_cdrsb_biomarker_for_forest <- function(d,
                                          biomarker,
                                          timevar = "time_yrs",
                                          id = "subject_label",
                                          outcome = "cdrsb",
                                          covars = NULL,
                                          ci_method = "boot",
                                          REML = FALSE,
                                          # for display
                                          clean_regex = c("_FTP_SUVR_BL$", "_SUVR_BL$", "_BL$", "_bl$"),
                                          color_map = NULL) {
  # ---- checks + complete cases ----
  needed <- unique(c(outcome, id, timevar, biomarker, covars))
  miss <- setdiff(needed, names(d))
  if (length(miss) > 0) stop("Missing columns: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))

  dd <- d %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(needed)) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na()

  # ---- make biomarker z (predictor-standardized only) ----
  biom_z <- paste0(biomarker, "_z")
  dd[[biom_z]] <- as.numeric(scale(dd[[biomarker]]))

  # ---- formula builders ----
  rand_term <- paste0("(1 + ", timevar, " | ", id, ")")

  build_forms <- function(x) {
    full <- paste0(x, " * ", timevar)
    red  <- paste0(x, " + ", timevar)
    if (!is.null(covars) && length(covars) > 0) {
      full <- paste(c(full, covars), collapse = " + ")
      red  <- paste(c(red,  covars), collapse = " + ")
    }
    list(
      full = stats::as.formula(paste0(outcome, " ~ ", full, " + ", rand_term)),
      red  = stats::as.formula(paste0(outcome, " ~ ", red,  " + ", rand_term))
    )
  }

  get_term <- function(sm, x) {
    t1 <- paste0(x, ":", timevar)
    t2 <- paste0(timevar, ":", x)
    if (t1 %in% rownames(sm)) return(t1)
    if (t2 %in% rownames(sm)) return(t2)
    NA_character_
  }

  # ---- fit RAW models ----
  f_raw <- build_forms(biomarker)
  m_full_raw <- lmerTest::lmer(f_raw$full, data = dd, REML = REML)
  m_red_raw  <- lmerTest::lmer(f_raw$red,  data = dd, REML = REML)

  sm_raw <- summary(m_full_raw)$coefficients
  term_raw <- get_term(sm_raw, biomarker)
  if (is.na(term_raw)) stop("Interaction term not found (raw) for ", biomarker)

  beta_raw <- unname(sm_raw[term_raw, "Estimate"])
  p_raw    <- unname(sm_raw[term_raw, "Pr(>|t|)"])
  ci_raw   <- confint(m_full_raw, parm = term_raw, method = ci_method)
  ci_lo_raw <- ci_raw[1]; ci_hi_raw <- ci_raw[2]

  # ---- fit Z models (biomarker standardized only) ----
  f_z <- build_forms(biom_z)
  m_full_z <- lmerTest::lmer(f_z$full, data = dd, REML = REML)
  m_red_z  <- lmerTest::lmer(f_z$red,  data = dd, REML = REML)

  sm_z <- summary(m_full_z)$coefficients
  term_z <- get_term(sm_z, biom_z)
  if (is.na(term_z)) stop("Interaction term not found (z) for ", biomarker)

  beta_z <- unname(sm_z[term_z, "Estimate"])
  p_z    <- unname(sm_z[term_z, "Pr(>|t|)"])
  ci_z   <- confint(m_full_z, parm = term_z, method = ci_method)
  ci_lo_z <- ci_z[1]; ci_hi_z <- ci_z[2]

  # ---- partial R2 interaction = Δ marginal R2 (Nakagawa) ----
  r2_full <- performance::r2_nakagawa(m_full_z)
  r2_red  <- performance::r2_nakagawa(m_red_z)
  delta_r2m <- unname(r2_full$R2_marginal - r2_red$R2_marginal)

  # ---- misc ----
  conv_raw <- is.null(m_full_raw@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages)
  conv_z   <- is.null(m_full_z@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages)

  n <- nrow(dd)
  n_id <- dplyr::n_distinct(dd[[id]])

  # label cleaning
  biomarker_clean <- biomarker
  for (rgx in clean_regex) biomarker_clean <- stringr::str_remove(biomarker_clean, rgx)

  # color (optional mapping)
  color <- "blue"
  if (!is.null(color_map)) {
    if (biomarker %in% names(color_map)) color <- unname(color_map[[biomarker]])
  }

  fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "", ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.2f", p)))

  annot <- sprintf(
  "%.2f [%.2f–%.2f], %.2f",
  beta_z, ci_lo_z, ci_hi_z,
  delta_r2m
)

  tibble::tibble(
    biomarker = biomarker,
    biomarker_clean = biomarker_clean,
    color = color,

    beta_z = beta_z,
    ci_lo_z = ci_lo_z,
    ci_hi_z = ci_hi_z,
    p_z = p_z,

    beta_raw = beta_raw,
    ci_lo_raw = ci_lo_raw,
    ci_hi_raw = ci_hi_raw,
    p_raw = p_raw,

    r2_interaction_marg = delta_r2m,

    n = n,
    n_id = n_id,
    converged_raw = conv_raw,
    converged_z = conv_z,

    annot = annot
  )
}
```

# plot marginal effect plot 
```{r}   
three_shades <- function(base_col) {
  grDevices::colorRampPalette(c("white", base_col, "black"))(3)
}

color_map <- c(
  centiloid_wcbl_bl = "lightgreen",
  log_ptau_bl       = "lightblue",
  desikan_suvr_bl   = "coral"
)

pretty_lab <- c(
  log_ptau_bl       = "log(p-tau)",
  centiloid_wcbl_bl = "Centiloid",
  desikan_suvr_bl   = "Cortical tau"
)

shade_df <- purrr::map_dfr(names(color_map), function(bm) {
  cols <- three_shades(color_map[[bm]])
  
  tibble::tibble(
    biomarker = bm,
    z_level = factor(c("−1 SD", "Mean", "+1 SD"),
                     levels = c("−1 SD", "Mean", "+1 SD")),
    col = cols
  )
})

make_marginal_interaction_df <- function(d,
                                         biomarker,
                                         timevar = "time_yrs",
                                         id = "subject_label",
                                         outcome = "cdrsb",
                                         covars = NULL,
                                         REML = FALSE,
                                         levels_z = c(-1, 0, 1),
                                         n_time = 120) {
  covars <- covars %||% character(0)

  needed <- unique(c(outcome, id, timevar, biomarker, covars))
  miss <- setdiff(needed, names(d))
  if (length(miss) > 0) stop("Missing columns: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))

  dd <- d %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(needed)) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na()

  biom_z <- paste0(biomarker, "_z")
  dd[[biom_z]] <- as.numeric(scale(dd[[biomarker]]))

  fixed_terms <- paste0(biom_z, " * ", timevar)
  if (length(covars) > 0) {
    fixed_terms <- paste(c(fixed_terms, covars), collapse = " + ")
  }

  fml <- as.formula(
    paste0(outcome, " ~ ", fixed_terms, " + (1 + ", timevar, " | ", id, ")")
  )
  fit <- lmerTest::lmer(fml, data = dd, REML = REML)

  t_seq <- seq(
    min(dd[[timevar]], na.rm = TRUE),
    max(dd[[timevar]], na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = n_time
  )

  ref_vals <- list()
  for (cv in covars) {
    x <- dd[[cv]]
    if (is.numeric(x)) {
      ref_vals[[cv]] <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      x2 <- as.character(x)
      ref_vals[[cv]] <- names(sort(table(x2), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
    }
  }

  newdat <- expand.grid(
    tmp_time = t_seq,
    tmp_bz   = levels_z,
    KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE
  )
  names(newdat)[names(newdat) == "tmp_time"] <- timevar
  names(newdat)[names(newdat) == "tmp_bz"]   <- biom_z

  if (length(covars) > 0) {
    for (cv in covars) newdat[[cv]] <- ref_vals[[cv]]
  }

  newdat[[id]] <- dd[[id]][1]

  X <- model.matrix(delete.response(terms(fit)), newdat)
  beta <- lme4::fixef(fit)
  V <- as.matrix(vcov(fit))

  pred <- as.numeric(X %*% beta)
  se <- sqrt(diag(X %*% V %*% t(X)))

  z_lab <- dplyr::case_when(
    newdat[[biom_z]] == -1 ~ "−1 SD",
    newdat[[biom_z]] ==  0 ~ "Mean",
    newdat[[biom_z]] ==  1 ~ "+1 SD",
    TRUE ~ as.character(newdat[[biom_z]])
  )

  out <- newdat %>%
    mutate(
      biomarker = biomarker,
      z_level = factor(z_lab, levels = c("−1 SD", "Mean", "+1 SD")),
      pred = pred,
      lo = pred - 1.96 * se,
      hi = pred + 1.96 * se
    )

  list(fit = fit, pred_df = out)
}

biomarkers <- c("log_ptau_bl", "centiloid_wcbl_bl", "desikan_suvr_bl")

res_list <- purrr::map(
  biomarkers,
  ~ make_marginal_interaction_df(
    d = df_long_filtered,
    biomarker = .x,
    timevar = "time_yrs",
    id = "subject_label",
    outcome = "cdrsb",
    covars = covariates,
    REML = FALSE
  )
)

pred_long <- purrr::map_dfr(res_list, "pred_df") %>%
  left_join(shade_df, by = c("biomarker", "z_level")) %>%
  mutate(
    biomarker_lab = factor(
      biomarker,
      levels = biomarkers,
      labels = pretty_lab[biomarkers]
    )
  )

pp <- ggplot(pred_long, aes(x = time_yrs, y = pred, group = z_level, color = col)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi, fill = col), alpha = 0.18, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ biomarker_lab) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 4), ylim = c(0, 18)) +
  theme_bw()
pp
 
```
